input.summary: Fix an off-by-one in `paginate` (src/utils.ts) so GET /items?limit=N returns at most N items instead of N+1. I also added tests/pagination.test.ts: one unit test for `paginate`, and one API test checking that `limit=2` returns 2 items and that the pages at offset 0 and offset 2 don't overlap. Full suite: 18 passed, 0 failed (16 baseline + 2 new). Lint (tsc --noEmit) passes.
input.root_cause: `paginate` called `items.slice(offset, offset + limit + 1)`. Because the end index of `slice` is already exclusive, the extra `+ 1` returned one item too many. That repeated the last item of each page as the first item of the next page.
